t: Nasir Khusraw开始了七年的中东之行,他将在后来的著作"萨法尔纳马"中加以描述.
te: Nasir Khusraw begins the seven-year Middle Eastern journey which he will later describe in his book Safarnama.
dz: Nasir Khusraw开始了七年的中东之行,他将在后来的著作"萨法尔纳马"中加以描述.
de: Nasir Khusraw begins the seven-year Middle Eastern journey which he will later describe in his book Safarnama.

t: 皇帝亨利三世召集了苏特里的同心合力来调解不同对教宗的主张者.
te: Emperor Henry III convenes the synod of Sutri to mediate between different claimants to the papacy.
dz: 皇帝亨利三世召集了苏特里的同心合力来调解不同对教宗的主张者.
de: Emperor Henry III convenes the synod of Sutri to mediate between different claimants to the papacy.

t: 亨利三世被教宗克莱门特二世加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
te: Henry III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor by Pope Clement II.
dz: 亨利三世被教宗克莱门特二世加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
de: Henry III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor by Pope Clement II.
